finding_key: packages/backend/src/logging/log-safe-url.ts::`logsafeurl` redacts only `/auth` query strings, so the share-link credential in `get /documents/:id/file?token=<share token>` is still written to the access log verbatim
evidence: Verified against the supplied files: `logSafeUrl` (log-safe-url.ts:22, `/^\/auth(?:\/|$)/`) only redacts query strings on `/auth`, and app.module.ts:70 applies it to `req.url` for every request. `document-file.controller.ts:40` does accept a share-link credential as `@Query('token')` and uses it in `assertCanRead` to grant read access, so that path's query string (token included) reaches pino unredacted — and app.module.ts's `customLogLevel` puts 4xx at `warn`, so rejected/mismatched-token attempts are logged at a level visible under the default `info`. The claim is factually correct about the code, though impact is dampened: a successful `GET /documents/:id/file` is a non-mutation and logs at `debug` (silent at default level), so only 4xx attempts (already-expired/wrong-document tokens, plus the 403 case where a valid token is presented for another document) surface by default, and the leak is pre-existing rather than introduced by this diff — it is an incompleteness of the newly added control.
